episodes.synopsis: The Phoenix Festa continues... Ayato and Julis are facing Luo and Song from Jie Long Academy!
episodes.title: Divine Revelations

episodes.synopsis: A young girl named Flora visits Julis. Meanwhile, Ayato tries to get in touch with Dirk Eberwein in the hope of getting some information regarding his sister, Haruka.
episodes.title: Corrupt Ruler

episodes.synopsis: Ayato and Julis are fighting against Shenyun and Shenhua Li in the quarterfinals. Since the twins are known to only attack their opponents’ weak points, what kind of a strategy will Ayato and Julis come up with?
episodes.title: Breaking the Memory Barrier

episodes.synopsis: Ayato and Julis continue their battle against Shenyun and Shenhua Li. Also, Saya and Kirin are facing AR-D and RM-C. Will the Seidoukan Academy live up to the high expectations?
episodes.title: Never Back Down

episodes.synopsis: Flora is abducted by a mysterious man. Now, Ayato and his friends have to come up with a plan to rescue her!
episodes.title: The Tyrant's Puppet Strings

episodes.synopsis: It's time for the semi-finals, where Ayato and Julis face Galahadworth’s True Knights. Meanwhile, Saya and Kirin search for the missing Flora.
episodes.title: Scrambling

episodes.synopsis: Ayato is looking around parts of the city, hoping to get a a trace about where Flora might be... Unfortunately, his efforts disturb certain people.
episodes.title: Battle Song

episodes.synopsis: Ayato and Julis face off against AR-D and RM-C in the Phoenix Festa finals, but Ayato is still without the Ser Veresta. Meanwhile, Saya and Kirin are trying to rescue Flora from her kidnapper. Can they save her in time?
episodes.title: The Phoenix Showdown

episodes.synopsis: The final match continues... Which team will win the Phoenix Festa?
episodes.title: Clinching Victory

episodes.synopsis: Ayato and his friends visit Lieseltania, where they are greeted with great enthusiasm! Surprisingly, Claudia has an interesting proposal for Ayato, Julis, Saya and Kirin.
episodes.title: Liseltania

episodes.synopsis: Julis’s brother, Jolbert, wants to discuss two important topics with Julis and Ayato. While spending time in Lieseltania, Julis runs into a face from her past.
episodes.title: The Lonely Strega

episodes.synopsis: Ayato wakes up three days after fighting Ophelia. Julis explains the story about Ophelia as she used to be a very kind girl, but with the orphanage in desperate need of money, she was sold off to be experimented on by the Arlequint scientist Hilda Jane Rowlands. She was artificially made into a Genestella that wilts any plants that she approaches. The capital is under attack by Gustave's chimeras, while he unleashes a hydra monster to attack Julis. Ayato, Julis, and Saya defeat the hydra while Kirin arrests Gustave. As everybody heads back to Seidoukan, Julis lets Jolbert know that she intends to change Lieseltania and commits herself to fighting in the Gryps Festa. Back at Seidoukan, Ayato sees Haruka's comatose body. He is approached by Hilda and despite being aware of what she did with Ophelia, Ayato allows her to operate on Haruka.
episodes.title: Reunion
